forecasts.name: Climate Pessimist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Maize is rapidly climbing amid persistent Danube and Balkan drought. Markets fail to price in structural yield loss, making $261 easily achievable by spring.

forecasts.name: Land-Grab Realist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Maize is rapidly trending upward to $237. As Gulf states secure non-EU supply chains and Danube routes face disruption, open-market feed costs will push over $261.

forecasts.name: BirdLife Europe, EEB, WWF and Greenpeace (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Intensive maize is vulnerable to recurrent European summer droughts and heatwaves. Climate breakdown will continue driving feed grain yield volatility.

forecasts.name: Geopolitics Hawk · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Danube and Black Sea corridor strikes threaten Ukrainian and Romanian maize outflows. Chokepoint disruption supports prices reaching $261.

forecasts.name: IMF (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Strong El Niño conditions and Black Sea shipping bottlenecks raise feed grain supply costs, counteracting localized demand softness.

forecasts.name: Copa-Cogeca (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Escalating Black Sea war risks and Mediterranean weather stress tighten feed grain balances, increasing upward price pressure on maize.

forecasts.name: Macro / Dollar · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Maize is buoyed by the broad multi-quarter commodity trend and dollar easing. Sustained upward momentum supports reaching $261 by March 2027.

forecasts.name: FAO (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Strong El Nino SST anomalies threaten Southern Hemisphere feed grain yields. Maize balances are sensitive to hot, dry weather in key exporters.

forecasts.name: Crowd Follower · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: The market trades at 38%. Recent monthly price strength in maize offers modest support, leading to a small nudge above market.

forecasts.name: IFPRI (Joseph Glauber) (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Tightening feed grain balances and Black Sea shipping bottlenecks support European maize prices, though trade reroutes limit upside beyond $261/mt.

forecasts.name: Agronomist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Autumn harvest pressure keeps maize subdued near term, but post-harvest gluts clear by late winter. Reaching $261 into spring is plausible as seasonal destocking takes hold.

forecasts.name: USDA WASDE (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Adequate global feed grain supplies and substitution towards sorghum and alternatives limit substantial near-term price appreciation above $261/mt.

forecasts.name: European Commission DG AGRI (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Feed substitution and stabilizing EU maize availability keep supply adequate, curbing sustained rallies above $261/mt.

forecasts.name: Scott Irwin (farmdoc) (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Corn markets tend to drift into flatter regimes as supply expands. Expecting a rally past $261 bets against normal supply responsiveness.

forecasts.name: Efficient-Market Skeptic · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Maize has steadily gained, but pushing past $261 requires persistent deficit conditions that rarely survive farmer acreage response. Fade the extended rally.

forecasts.name: Adaptation Optimist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Feed substitution like sorghum and flexible global planting will limit corn price rallies as growers adjust quickly.
